decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted and numbered Design and Access Statement, GL-101, XL-103, SW-105, LP-200, GL-201, XL-203, SW-205, Received 20 December 2011   therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The rating level of any noise generated by plant & equipment as part of the development shall be at least 10 dB below the pre-existing background level as determined by BS4142: 1997-"Method of rating industrial noise affecting mixed residential and industrial areas".
Condition : 4 - The use of the retail unit hereby approved at 1 Essex Place Square shall not be carried out outside the hours of 08.00 and 19.00, Monday to Sunday.

Condition : 5 - The use hereby permitted shall not commence until the extract/ventilation systems shown on the approved plans have been installed in accordance with the approved plans, and thereafter shall be permanently retained.

Condition : 6 - The use hereby permitted shall not commence until the refuse store, and area/facilities allocated for storing of recyclable materials, as shown on the approved plans have been completed in accordance with the approved plans. Thereafter, all refuse and recyclable materials associated with the development shall either be stored within this dedicated store/area, as shown on the approved plans at the site at 1 Essex Place Square. No refuse or recycling material shall be stored or placed for collection on the public highway or pavement, or within the parking and loading area at the rear of the premises.

Condition : 7 - The ramp access and automated swing double doors shown on the approved plans shall be installed, and provision made for level access into both the London Hotel School Reception and the A1 retail premises through the secondary door, prior to the commencement of the use hereby permitted. The access  through the lobby of the building shall be permanently retained thereafter.
description: Change of use of the school cafe (D1) to retail (A1) use with alterations to the shopfront.
